messages:
zoe: ran the new mac installer (0.14.0) and now `redwoodctl whoami` returns an anonymous user even though my browser auth completed successfully.
rishi: did you have an old `~/.redwood/config` from pre-0.12? the migrator should import profiles but i've seen flakes.
zoe: I had a `profiles.yaml` with `profile: dev-main`, and the installer printed "migrated legacy config" but now `~/.redwood/current` points to `default` and `redwoodctl` seems to prefer it.
zoe: `redwoodctl --profile dev-main whoami` shows my user ok. but normal `redwoodctl whoami` triggers a device-code prompt and then gets into a refresh loop: 
```
$ redwoodctl whoami
Opening browser for device code auth...
Waiting for code...
ERROR: auth: token refresh failed: invalid_grant
Retrying (1/3)...
Opening browser for device code auth...
...
```
tony: that smells like the CLI is reading two different profile stores: the legacy `~/.redwood/profiles.yaml` and the new managed `~/.config/redwood/profiles.json`. installer should set the symlink but sometimes it creates a stale `current` file instead.
nina: can you paste `cat ~/.redwood/current` and `env | grep REDWOOD`?
zoe: `cat ~/.redwood/current` -> `default`
zoe: `echo $REDWOOD_PROFILE` -> (empty)
zoe: i can workaround by setting `export REDWOOD_PROFILE=dev-main` but that shouldn't be required after migration.
rishi: thanks, that's consistent. workaround is fine short-term. i'll add a safegaurd in the migrator: if new profiles.json exists, write `current` to match the most recently used profile from the old file rather than blindly writing `default`. also add a guard so `redwoodctl` prefers the env var, then `~/.redwood/current`, then config file—explicit order in code.
bot-ci: CI check: failing e2e for `installer::migrate_profiles` on macos-latest (flaky) — attaching logs.
bot-ci: "migrator: wrote current -> default (no legacy recently-used found)"
zoe: thx. also small UX ask: when `whoami` triggers a device-code flow while a stale `current` is present, show a hint like "profile mismatch? try `REDWOOD_PROFILE=...` or run `redwoodctl profile list`." Right now the error just loops.
tony: good idea. i'll add a friendly suggestion on auth retry failure and a cap to not auto-restart the browser flow more than 2 times in 60s. that should stop the noisy loop.
rishi: created PR github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/5910 -> "installer: better profile migration and stop write-default-current"
rishi: also opened issue to add migration e2e and a CLI runtime check `redwoodctl doctor` that reports divergent profile sources.
zoe: verified local fix by manually editing `~/.redwood/current` to `dev-main` and `redwoodctl whoami` now works. thanks team. :sparkles:
nina: nice. i'll add a short note in the upgrade guide and the mac installer release notes so customers know to set REDWOOD_PROFILE if they hit this.
